title: Tenant Operating System Studio Convergence Contracts

phases.objective: Provide a repository-native convergence specification whose package, installation, lifecycle, Draft portfolio, Work Map, semantic ontology, current-main authority reuse matrix, candidate evidence, no-secret, and truthful completion contracts validate without granting runtime mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the Spec-local contract, authority-convergence, live-delta, and Tenant audit validators from the exact candidate tree
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The portfolio snapshots, current-main authority/reuse inventory at 0faee775cd0572b737fed8bc74e2580d9fca2878, canonical 30-concept map, T002/T003 evidence closure, T006/T008 open owner decisions, Work Map, completion state, and no-secret boundaries pass while implementation remains unstarted.
steps: Validate the exact Spec manifest inventory and specification-only boundaries.
Validate package, installation, lifecycle, candidate-convergence, Draft portfolio, live-delta, and OpenAPI contracts.
Validate canonical semantic ownership for Intent, Action, Capability, Operation, Tool, Skill, Agent, Workflow, Activity Pack, Solution Package, runtime artifacts, and projections.

Validate the current-main authority matrix maps Package/Component/Installation/Capability/Operation/Tool/Agent/Skill/Workflow/Activity Pack/MCP/Manifest and legacy Action semantics to current authorities or explicit owner-decision gaps.
Validate current package/version/install authorities are reuse inputs and copied grant/policy JSON remains compatibility-only.
Validate T002/T003 are repository-inventory/reuse evidence complete while T006/T008 remain open.
Validate the immutable 34-PR base snapshot and append-only 35-PR live-delta contracts separately from the newer current-main authority inventory.
Validate all 19 Work Maps and 16 schema domains have explicit decisions while Spec 015 runtime implementation remains blocked.
Validate completion truthfulness and scan the complete Spec directory for prohibited secret patterns.
assertions: No numeric Spec number, Tool visibility, Package reference, Skill assignment, Agent reasoning, Installation Revision, Execution Capsule, Effective Runtime Manifest, or projection independently grants execution authority.
No wholesale solution_package_* persistence is approved by T002/T003 evidence closure.
platform_private_packages, platform_package_versions, tenant_package_installs, canonical_capabilities, Growth Control Activity Packs, and SystemToolCatalogV2 are mandatory reuse inputs where mapped.
Legacy actions and historical capability-authority aliases remain explicit T006 convergence work, not silent runtime renames.
Specification completion cannot be interpreted as runtime, migration, provider, deployment, or Production completion.
Candidate snapshots remain read-only evidence; candidate reconstruction and merge remain unexecuted.

phases.objective: Implement package/component authorities and deterministic installation compilation by extending/reusing current-main substrates, then add custom entities, lifecycles, forms, file policies, AI definitions, generated tenant-safe surfaces, and reviewed external projections through bounded child PRs.
blockers: T006 canonical identity/cutover decisions remain open for duplicate Spec identities, legacy Action/Operation semantics, and capability authority aliases.
T008 owner approval remains open for package authority extension, generic component gaps, installation revisions, security/privacy/product boundaries, and external integration.
Package publication semantics and generic component identity/dependency persistence are not approved.
Immutable installation revision and typed requirement-binding persistence are not approved.
Spec 016/017 external MCP/OAuth/host-isolation gates remain open.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Tenant system designer and package reviewer
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Create and compile a private tenant package using approved extensions of existing package/version/install authorities
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: The package validates, installs for an exact Brand in sandbox, produces a deterministic immutable installation revision, and exposes tenant-safe generated or reviewed external surfaces without implicit authority.
steps: Reuse or extend current package/version authorities and reference canonical component assets rather than copying them.
Compile the exact target installation with typed bindings, lineage, conflicts, revision vector, and deterministic hash.
Run sandbox acceptance and prove UI, form, MCP, resource, and operation authority remains server-enforced.

phases.objective: Prove upgrades, rollback, provider/manual fallback, backup/restore, drift reconciliation, delegation revocation, export, handover continuity, and external integration disable/revocation.
blockers: Operational package and installation runtime is not implemented.
Reference packages, infrastructure services, agency/client delegation, and external integration journeys are not reconstructed.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Agency operator, client owner, integration operator, and release reviewer
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Upgrade one client installation with local overrides, simulate dependency degradation, revoke an external connection, and execute a client handover
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Conflicts are explicit, rollback is verified, external and agency delegation is revoked, and the client-owned system continues under client principals.
steps: Run three-way package upgrade and block ambiguous local customization conflicts.
Exercise manual/provider fallback, backup/restore, and prior-revision rollback.
Revoke external and agency access, transfer dependencies, and verify continuity plus former-operator denial.

phases.objective: Run bounded pilots for a freelancer, an agency with two client Brands, a client-owned Tenant, reference packages including Content Intelligence, and a read-only ChatGPT/MCP external integration cohort.
blockers: Operational and resilient acceptance suites are incomplete.
Pilot Tenants, Brands, packages, services, external connections, effects, budgets, and stop rules are not approved.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Authorized pilot tenants, client reviewers, ChatGPT Developer mode testers, and platform operators
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Author, install, activate, and operate bounded package installations and approved read-only external tools
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Tenant models and external reads operate with isolation, usable surfaces, health/cost evidence, fallback, rollback, revocation, and handover readiness.
steps: Pilot one freelancer-created system and one agency package installed for two isolated client Brands.
Pilot a client-owned Tenant with delegated agency access and tested revocation.
Run approved reference targets under package-specific gates, including Content Intelligence only after its package foundation exists.
Connect the approved read-only MCP surface in Developer mode and verify scoped discovery, denial, bounded output, disable, and revocation.

phases.objective: Verify governed migrations, Production runtime, package/generated/external-surface parity, health, isolation, backup/restore, rollback, support, handover, and truthful closeout.
blockers: Canary acceptance and Production release authority do not exist.
No package runtime migration, deployment, public plugin review, Production canary, or post-merge audit has been executed.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Authorized release operator and tenant pilot owners
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Promote an exact verified release candidate through governed deployment, migration, and external-integration release paths
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Production runs intended package, installation, and reviewed external surface revisions with healthy runtime, isolation, fallback, rollback, revocation, handover continuity, and complete closeout evidence.
steps: Verify exact-head CI, migration evidence, main/Production parity, active package configuration, and reviewed external metadata.
Run bounded Production health, generated/external surface, isolation, fallback, revocation, and rollback readback.
Complete post-merge audit and explicitly classify all remaining work.
